High-Quality Chiropractic ASMR Videos. 

In the beginning, this channel had 1 intention. To make cool videos for people who watch chiropractic for ASMR relaxation and sleep. 

THEN... the revenue helped me start a non profit that gives people with financial hardship QUALITY chiropractic. 

THANK YOU! 

Pain Relief Chiropractic is located in Mechanicsburg, PA. We see patients from all over the country offering the same extended, detailed visits that are seen on this channel.  

Want to visit? Check out Our Google Reviews!

Your extended visit will include more dialogue than seen here. 

The only service that must be requested is the pulse reading. 

Teaching
Central Penn College 2008: Anatomy & Physiology
Penn State University 2009-2019: Human Biology, General Biology, Mammalian Anatomy,  Nutrition.

Teaching Professional Seminars
Germany, UK, and Turkey 2019, 2024 

EXTREMELY BUSY!
